name: jira-monitor
description: Side pane listing open Jira issues assigned to me, via the Jira Cloud REST API

email.title: Atlassian account email
email.description: Email used for Jira API basic auth

apiToken.title: Jira API token
apiToken.description: Atlassian API token; falls back to the JIRA_API_TOKEN environment variable when empty

jql.title: JQL
jql.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane re-fetches issues

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of issues fetched per refresh (1-100)
